answer: Farming becomes a wander bet on surviving 97 epochs of grading, and every delta settlement recomputes the ember schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 97 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
